== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Dragons are powerful, often serpentine beings characterized by their immense destructive capabilities and inherent arrogance. Historically, they ruled the land before a great disaster forced them from the sky, an event that led to their connection with the [[Blackflame ancestors]]. They possess a natural sense of superiority, acting with absolute certainty and refusing to hesitate or negotiate. While many believe them to be mere myths, they are real entities that can manifest in various forms, ranging from massive sky-dwelling serpents to smaller, more animalistic creatures like lizards or feathered drakes. Dragons exhibit a wide variety of physical traits and abilities; some use claws, fangs, and tails, while others breathe specialized flames, such as liquid red-and-black fire or orange-gold streams. Their power levels vary significantly, with classifications such as [[Highgold]] and [[Truegold]] existing, alongside more powerful entities like the [[Underlord]]-level dragons. Some dragons can adopt human forms to facilitate their [[advancement]], often appearing as individuals with subtle draconic features like [[scales]] on their skin. Notable figures and types include the Black dragons{{!}}black dragons, who were once kings of a continent, and the Gold dragons{{!}}gold dragons, who served beneath them. Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon is a particularly formidable [[Dreadgod]] that resides in the upper atmosphere on a bed of clouds, possessing high intelligence and a capacity for cunning despite its beast-like appearance. Dragons are also associated with specific symbols, such as a coiling [[dragon]] surrounded by lightning and rain. Their essence can be harnessed through certain paths to devour their physical and spiritual strength, further emphasizing their role as primary sources of immense power.}}
